item.title: Businessman charged with giving RM8 million bribe to approve loan
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Businessman and former Managing Director of V Telecoms Berhad Datuk Ranjeet Singh Sidhu today pleaded not guilty in the Sessions Court here to a charge of giving a bribe of RM8 million to a former president of a bank, 14 years ago. Ranjeet, 56, is accused of giving the bribe to the former president and managing director of the bank through an individual as payment for helping to approve a RM400 million loan application by Syarikat V Telecoms Berhad. item.title: Sacked from Bersatu, Hamzah and 18 allied MPs pledge support for new PAS leadership of PN
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR (Feb 23): In a significant political realignment, sacked Bersatu deputy president Datuk Seri Hamzah Zainudin and 18 other MPs aligned with him have pledged their full support to the new Perikatan Nasional (PN) chairman Datuk Seri Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar of PAS. item.title: Auditor-General Flags RM28.13 Million Unapproved Spending in MyDigital ID Project
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Auditor-General’s Report 1/2026 (LKAN 1/2026) has revealed that RM28.13 million was spent on the MyDigital ID (MyDID) Project under the management of MIMOS Bhd without approval from the designated committee. The report, tabled in the Dewan Rakyat on Monday, identified weaknesses in expenditure management and internal controls during the early implementation phase of the MyDID Project.
